title: Trade Stocks on Binance: Buy and Sell U.S. Stocks and ETFs from Your Binance Account
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Today, Binance is opening the door to a new era of investing. Users can now trade U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs on Binance, making it easier to access both crypto and traditional financial assets on one platform. With a single Binance account, users can explore thousands of stocks and ETFs, starting from just $5. This marks an important step in Binance’s mission to build a more seamless and accessible financial experience for users around the world. With stocks now available alongside crypto on Binance, users can diversify more easily, respond to market opportunities faster, and manage more of their portfolios from a platform they already trust. Why Trade Stocks on Binance One Account, More Markets Binance brings crypto and stocks together in one unified experience. Instead of switching between apps to manage different asset classes, users can now access stocks and ETFs alongside their crypto holdings - all from the same account. Access 7,000+ U.S.-Listed Stocks and ETFs Explore a broad range of U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs, including many of the world’s most recognized companies and funds. Start Small with Fractional Shares Investing in stocks doesn’t require a large upfront commitment. With fractional shares starting from just $5, users can build their exposure over time at their own pace. Trade 24/5 Trade stocks 24 hours a day, five days a week, allowing for more flexibility to react to market movements across time zones. Crypto-Native Convenience Get started with a seamless, crypto-native experience. Purchase stocks directly using supported balances on Binance, including select stablecoins and BNB. Low-Cost Access Trade U.S. stocks and ETFs with  zero commission fees , plus a minimum platform fee of $0.35 per order or 10 bps for orders above $350, offering a cost-efficient way to access the market. Stock Trading on Binance: Built for the Modern Investor Today’s users don’t think in silos. They want access to multiple markets, flexible trading hours, and a platform that fits how they already manage their finances. Stocks trading on Binance is designed for both crypto-native users looking to start trading stocks and stock traders seeking a more unified, global investing experience.  Whether diversifying beyond crypto for the first time or looking for a more convenient way to access both crypto and stocks, Binance offers a simpler path forward. A More Connected Investing Experience For years, users often had to choose between crypto-first platforms and stock-first brokerages. Binance is changing that. By bringing stocks and ETFs onto Binance, users can manage a more diversified portfolio in one place: from Bitcoin and BNB to leading U.S. stocks and ETFs. It’s a more connected investing experience built for a world where financial access should be simple, global, and flexible. Soon to Come Binance will also soon launch  bStocks , tokenized securities which are representations of select U.S. stocks and ETFs. Users will be able to easily convert their equity holdings on Binance to on-chain assets. The official launch of bStocks is planned for the coming weeks and we will release more information once available. Note: bStocks Tokenized Securities are classified as Certificates representing certain Financial Instruments (paragraph 92, Schedule 1 to FSMR). bStocks are not stocks and bStocks do not allow holders to directly own a share or stock in the underlying listed company.
